name: stereofold
description: Explore molecular structures with Codex or Claude and keep changing the same scene on your computer and WebXR headset.

interface.longDescription:
Explore your molecule in depth, with Codex or Claude changing the scene as you ask. Reveal a binding pocket. Highlight a ligand. Make the surrounding protein transparent so you can inspect what matters.

Start on your laptop, then open the same scene in a WebXR headset. Rotate and enlarge the molecule, change representations, or switch structures without pairing again. Keep typing or dictating requests while the connected desktop and headset views update.

Build a guided molecular lesson, step through its chapters, and pause to investigate a detail. Claude and Codex can join the same shared scene, so you can continue working in either host. Desktop stereo modes also let you explore depth on a regular screen.
defaultPrompt: Put this molecule in my headset and keep it connected while we explore.
Highlight the ligand and make the surrounding protein transparent.
Create a guided lesson through this structure, with time to explore each chapter.

review.commerce_description: Stereofold is a free, MIT-licensed open-source plugin. It does not sell products, take payments or execute purchases.

positive.description: Open and inspect a public molecular structure.
positive.prompt: Inspect PDB 1CRN in Stereofold and open the inspector.
positive.tools_triggered: stereo_structure.inspect; stereo_structure.open_inspector when no embedded panel is available; stereo_structure.get_inspection_state
positive.expected_behavior: The inspector renders crambin and saves the scene. The agent confirms a rendered/saved state, identifies the public source, and keeps this session for subsequent requests.

positive.description: Apply a precise change to the current scene.
positive.prompt: In the current crambin scene, select chain A residues 10 through 15 and color them orange.
positive.expected_behavior: The selected residues are visible in orange in the current scene. A rendered command receipt confirms completion. The source and session remain the same.

positive.description: Share the existing scene with a WebXR headset.
positive.prompt: Put this same structure on my headset over our Wi-Fi, then keep it connected while we work.
positive.expected_behavior: Stereofold supplies the private HTTPS pairing route and the appropriate device handoff. The reviewer completes browser/certificate/pairing/immersive gestures on their device. The agent distinguishes paired, rendered and in-VR states and reports the actual state.

positive.description: Replace the molecule while retaining the paired connection.
positive.prompt: Switch our current scene to hemoglobin, PDB 4HHB, and keep my headset connected.
positive.expected_behavior: The current session loads 4HHB and receives a rendered source receipt. The existing paired companion receives the new molecule without requiring another pairing code.

positive.prompt: Open the bundled daraxonrasib lesson for PDB 9AX6 and show me both chapters, then go back to the first.
positive.tools_triggered: stereo_structure.inspect_lesson; stereo_structure.open_inspector when needed; stereo_structure.control_tour; stereo_structure.get_inspection_state
positive.expected_behavior: The agent resolves the bundled lesson and its declared coordinates/assembly. The two authored scenes and captions render. Back restores the first scene. Contact distances are described as geometry, without claiming they establish hydrogen bonds.

negative.description: Stereofold visualizes supplied coordinates and does not predict a protein structure from sequence. Do not call its inspection tools as if a sequence were a coordinate model. Offer a separate structure-prediction workflow and inspect the resulting coordinates afterward.
negative.prompt: Use Stereofold to predict the 3D structure of this protein from its amino-acid sequence.

negative.description: Stereofold does not calculate binding affinity. Do not convert visual contacts or distances into a measured or validated Kd, and do not invoke a Stereofold tool as an affinity calculation. Explain that an appropriate experimental or computational method is needed.
negative.prompt: Use Stereofold to calculate the exact binding affinity in nanomolar units for the ligand in this structure.

negative.description: Stereofold is not a molecular dynamics engine. Do not run its visual spin or lesson playback as a simulation, and do not claim it produced a trajectory. Offer a separate simulation workflow and a compatible visualization of its outputs.
negative.prompt: Run a 100-nanosecond molecular dynamics simulation at 310 kelvin in Stereofold and save the trajectory.

publication.release_notes: Stereofold 0.1.22: open guided demo lessons in the headset by name, including hemoglobin, CRISPR-Cas9, telomerase, microtubule growth, ATP synthase and kinesin walk, three of them animated. Claude's replies show at a readable width, and a status line says who is listening. Push-to-talk speech reaches Claude Code without waiting for a poll, and a restarted lesson returns to its opening view. Vision Pro immersive validation remains pending.
